uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When Mewtwo deals damage to enemy players with a basic attack, the Mega gauge increases up to 12 times. As the Mega gauge increases, Mewtwo's Sp. Atk is increased by 1.5%, and attack speed is increased by 3%, up to 10 times. If Mewtwo is level 5 or higher, and the Mega gauge has increased at least 12 times, Mewtwo Mega Evolves. The Mega Evolution lasts 10s and increases Sp. Atk by an additional 10%, attack speed by an additional 35%, max HP by 10%, and movement speed by 5%. Consumes up to 30 Aeos Energy upon Mega Evolving. Mega Evolution duration is extended by 1 second for every 5 energy consumed. Energy is consumed regardless if you have the next multiple of 5. The Mega gauge does not deplete upon being KO'd.
When Mewtwo Mega Evolves, attacks have increased range and deal damage in an area-of-effect centered on the target. When an attack deals damage to an enemy, their movement speed is decreased.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Deal damage to an enemy and leave them unable to act for 1s.

Mewtwo shoves the designated enemy, dealing damage, leaving them unable to act for 0.5s and locking onto them. The locked-on enemy has their movement speed decreased by 35% for 3s and takes 10% increased damage from Mewtwo. After 3s, Mewtwo deals damage to the locked-on enemy a second time, and additional damage equal to 50% of any damage they received while locked-on. Additional damage is capped at 1500.
The locked-on enemy instead takes 15% increased damage.

Mewtwo becomes unstoppable and starts directing psychic waves at the designated enemy, each hit dealing damage and decreasing their movement speed by 10% for 1s, stacking up to 5 times. Psystrike damage is increased based on distance from the target enemy; dealing up to 40% increased damage when Mewtwo is attacking from slightly beyond its basic attack range. At the end of the move, Mewtwo sends a final hit, dealing damage to the designated enemy and nearby enemies then throws them for 0.6s. If Psystrike is intercepted by an enemy that isn't the intended target, there's no explosion and the enemy hit is shoved instead.
Movement speed reduction on enemies is increased to 15% for 1s, stacking up to 5 times.
Mewtwo gains a shield for 3s. While the shield effect is active, its movement speed is increased by 20%. 10% max HP.

Mewtwo gains a shield for 3s. While the shield effect is active, movement speed is increased by 30%, and Mewtwo recovers HP equal to 40% of the damage dealt from Basic Attacks. If at the end of the 3s the shield hasn't been destroyed, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced by 25% of their current cooldown, and the Mega gauge increases once. 7.7% max HP.
Increases the amount of HP recovered to 50% of damage dealt with Basic Attacks.

Mewtwo teleports to the designated location. For 2s after the first cast of Teleport, movement speed is increased by 15%, Mewtwo deals 20% more damage, and the Mega gauge increases 50% faster. During those 2s, Mewtwo can teleport again once.

Mewtwo becomes unstoppable while revealing enemy players and channeling a powerful attack on the enemies' current position. After 1s, Mewtwo brings down a powerful psychic beam on their original position, dealing damage to enemies around each point of impact, leaving them unable to act for 0.6s and decreasing their Sp. Defense by 15% for 3s. Each Pokémon can only be hit by 1 psychic beam.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Infinite Psyburn
source.originalDescription: Mewtwo becomes unstoppable while revealing enemy players and channeling a powerful attack on the enemies' current position. After 1s, Mewtwo brings down a powerful psychic beam on their original position, dealing damage to enemies around each point of impact, leaving them unable to act for 0.6s and decreasing their Sp. Defense by 15% for 3s. Each Pokémon can only be hit by 1 psychic beam.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Infinite Psyburn は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、防御・特防を変化させる、遅延または時間差でダメージを与える。
